decisions_log.decision: Breaking pill renders visible 'Breaking' text via aria-hidden span alongside a sr-only 'Breaking change:' span placed before the h2 in DOM order.
decisions_log.rationale: The sr-only span gives screen readers the full accessible text 'Breaking change:' before the title; the aria-hidden span provides the concise visual label. getNodeText in testing-library only checks direct text nodes, so the sr-only span is the unique match for /breaking change:/i in tests, avoiding ambiguous multi-element matches.

decisions_log.decision: Amber pill uses bg-amber-100/text-amber-800 (light) and bg-amber-900/40/text-amber-300 (dark).
decisions_log.rationale: Estimated contrast ratios: light ~7.5:1, dark ~9.5:1 — both exceed the WCAG 2.1 AA threshold of 4.5:1 for small text. Visually distinct from the muted zinc-400/500 date and reading-time styling.

decisions_log.decision: AC6 RSS test uses matchAll to isolate individual <item> elements before asserting, instead of a cross-item greedy regex.
decisions_log.rationale: The design.json suggested regex matched from the first <item> to the Copy tweak </item>, causing the breaking item content to appear in the match. Per-item matching with matchAll is more robust.

decisions_log.decision: AC7–AC11 (sandbox-changelog-api criteria) are not implemented here — this is the site-only repository.
decisions_log.rationale: The task.md explicitly scopes work to this repository. The API changes belong in a separate run against sandbox-changelog-api.

decisions_log.decision: Both type declarations (ChangelogEntryData in the component and ChangelogEntry in the RSS route) remain separate — no consolidation into a shared module.
decisions_log.rationale: The design marks consolidation as a deferred decision out of scope for this feature. Both are updated independently per the SWE constraints.

deferred_questions.question: AC7–AC11 are not covered in this repository. They describe sandbox-changelog-api behaviour (breaking normalisation, ?breaking=true filter, 400 on other values, empty-list 200). Those changes must be implemented in a separate run against the sandbox-changelog-api repository.

AC10 (existing entries byte-identical after merge) is structural/integration: it can be verified by diff, not a unit test. No new test is added for it; the existing changelog-data tests continue asserting the four known entries are present and their fields match. The constraint is upheld — data/changelog.json was not modified.

npm run build fails with a Google Fonts network error (next/font cannot reach fonts.googleapis.com in this offline environment). This is a pre-existing infrastructure limitation unrelated to the feature changes; lint and tests pass.

files_changed.summary: Added `breaking?: boolean` to ChangelogEntryData type; rendered an amber Breaking pill with sr-only 'Breaking change:' text in DOM order before the h2 title when breaking is true.
Added `breaking?: boolean` to the local ChangelogEntry type; emits '[Breaking] ' prefix on <title> and <category>breaking</category> element inside each <item> whose entry has breaking===true.
Extended data-shape test to update the local type to include `breaking?: boolean` and added a test that validates the field is boolean when present.

New test file covering AC1, AC2, AC3, and AC12: Breaking pill rendered when breaking:true; no pill when absent/false; 'Breaking change:' precedes title in textContent; each breaking entry gets its own pill.
New test file covering AC4, AC5, AC6: [Breaking] prefix on RSS title for breaking entry; <category>breaking</category> present in breaking item; non-breaking entry has neither prefix nor category.

self_assessment.notes: AC7–AC11 belong to sandbox-changelog-api (separate repo). AC1–AC6 and AC12 are fully implemented and tested. AC10 is verified by the unchanged data/changelog.json file. All 174 tests pass. Lint clean. Build network failure is pre-existing and unrelated to this change.
